ANIMADVERSIO." and an italic title centred above the second paragraph. No block below the text, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: itàin[?] hac quæstione, de Principum depositione, hos Arietes, sed Rationales. existimare par est; nec igitur habendos esse tanquàm pecudes meras: nam omnia ferre si possint, & debent, pulsandum Pontificis pedi præbendum quandóque Caput. Vt de Causis omnibus, quas pro deponendis Principibus Pontifex fingere possit, breuiter concludam; Vbi Principibus pœnam Temporalem infligendi Ius non est, ibi eidem pœnæ Causa prætexi iusta nulla potest. At vbi in Scripturis de Principibus dicitur, Psal.104 15.{z}Noli tangere vnctos meos, ibi non hominis vox sonat, sed oraculum planè diuinum, quod vetus Theologia per totum Orbem Christianum docuit & celebrauit: quódque antiqui Pontifices sanctè coluerunt, qui, in Arietibus cogendis, semper ad Anathemata, tanquam ad arma vltima, confugerunt. * confugerunt.
main_text.head: IV. ANIMADVERSIO.

head.i: Causæ superiores, propter quas Principes deponendos censent Pontifices, sigillatim recensentur; & earum omnium Pontifices ipsi Rei peraguntur.

main_text.p: EX causis, quas attulistis, pro deponendis Principibus Catholicis, prima fuit iuris vsurpatio in Electione Episcopo-rum, & Abbatum; quùm tamen Pontifices Rom.diù Imper-tores[?] Constantinopolitanos pacificè tulerint, etiamsi {a}Onuphr. decreat. Pontif. & Cardin. in vita Agath.I.Absq; eorum[?] confirmatione, & nisi solutâ prius pro Confirmatione pecuniâ Pontifices ordinari non poterant: tandem Agatho I. Papa An.Dom.DCLXXXIX.[?] hoc priuilegium ab Imperatore abtinuit, vt hàc pessimâ confuetudine sublatâ, Pontifex electus non sine Imperatoris assensu consecraretur, quæ ille gratis dare tenebatur.

De his supra, cap.1 §.24.Secunda est Iniuria in Papam, qui sæpè sine causa quiritatur; quid igitur? Cùm Princeps aut à Papa ad Concilium prouocandū censuerit; aut Calceū Pontificis exosculari recusauerit: si Papa de illata sibi iniuria vehementius postulauerit; an propterea Coronâ suâ spoliandus est Princeps? * Iniusta oratio; cùm præsertim complures Pontifices nefarias & immanes iniurias in suos Prædecessores exercuisse confteant, nec tamen Pontificatu abdicati sint.
Tertia, Arrogatio Iuris in tollendo Schismate tum gli-scente

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "itàin" (line-start word, spacing unclear); "Imper-tores" at the line end, the second part of the word is uncertain; the year "DCLXXXIX" is read from the reversed-C numerals and may be misread; the stray "e" mark before "rum" after "Absq;" is not explained by a margin note, and I have kept only the "a" mark; the mark before "Noli" was read as "z" and is uncertain. The "Sect: XV." label is set in the margin beside the heading and is placed inside that heading. The "Cap.2." in the running head is included as printed. The "*" marks before "Iniusta" and after "confugerunt." are printed asterisks, kept as they stand. The paragraph "Tertia..." runs on to the next page.
